name: kdeconnect
description: A phone as a device, through the KDE Connect app: share a picture, a document or a link from the phone straight into her chat; she reads the texts on it and, when allowed, answers as its owner; a notification from her on the phone; battery; ring it to find it. Adds the Phone device type to Settings > Devices. Sapphire pairs with the phone like a desktop would; the protocol is spoken here, no fork of theirs.
author: sapphire

config_schema.label: Phone
config_schema.help: Phones running KDE Connect on this network. Open the app on the phone and it appears here within a few seconds, with its pairing state under it. Pair it right here: press Pair and accept on the phone (the same 8-character key shows on both), or request pairing in the phone's app and press Accept pairing. A phone that is not paired cannot be added.

config_schema.label: Talks in chat
config_schema.help: The chat its texts and what it shares land in. Empty = the chat that is open. A name that is not a chat yet is made when you save.

config_schema.label: A picture or file shared from the phone

options.label: Goes into the chat, and is kept as a file
Is kept as a file only

config_schema.help: Into the chat: she sees the picture, or reads the document, and answers. Kept: the file is saved under user/plugin_state/kdeconnect_inbox, and a document also goes into the chat's documents. Text and links always go into the chat.

config_schema.label: Texts wake her
config_schema.help: A text message arriving on the phone starts a turn in the chat: she reads it and answers there, and may text back as you. Works only while Sapphire may use this (the switch above). Off = texts are read only when she asks.
